hassio_confirm.title: Centrometal Local MQTT Protocol
hassio_confirm.description: Add the boiler served by the Centrometal Local MQTT Protocol app?

abort.app_required: This integration works together with the Centrometal Local MQTT Protocol app. Install and start the app from the app store: it announces itself, and the boiler appears here under Discovered. See the documentation of the repository.

app_version_mismatch.title: Update the Centrometal Local MQTT Protocol app and integration
app_version_mismatch.description: The app and the integration update separately, and these two versions no longer understand each other. Update both to the latest version, then restart Home Assistant.
